questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word‘ uniformity’
A great variety of birds is found in the sanctuaries of India.
questions.solution:
B) Uniformity (noun)– The quality or state of being uniform; overall sameness, homogeneity. एकरूपता
Antonym: Variety (noun)– The quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity or monotony. विविधता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
The repetitive and monotonous task of data entry made the work seem incredibly long and tedious
questions.solution:
B) Monotonous(adjective) – Dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest. नीरस
Antonym:Interesting(adjective) – Arousing curiosity or interest; holding or catching the attention. दिलचस्प

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The speaker delivered a profound speech that left the audience deeply moved.
questions.solution:
C) Profound(adjective) – Having deep insight or understanding; intense, thorough, meaningful. गहन
Antonym:Shallow(adjective) – Lacking depth of intellect or knowledge; superficial, trivial, simple. उथला

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word
The worker is known to exert himself a lot.
questions.solution:
C)Exert(verb) – To make a strenuous physical or mental effort. प्रयास करना
Antonym:Relax(verb) – To make or become less tense or anxious, to rest, to take it easy. आराम करना

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Freezing
questions.solution:
D)Freezing(adjective) – Very cold, icy, frosty. अत्यधिक ठंडा
Antonym:Tropical(adjective) – very hot and humid उष्णकटिबंधीय

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.
Confusing The stars twinkled in the dark sky, guiding travellers on their journey.
questions.solution:
A)Confusing(adjective) – Lacking clarity, puzzling, bewildering. भ्रमित करने वाला
Antonym:Guiding(adjective) – Directing or showing the way, leading, enlightening. मार्गदर्शन करने वाला

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Summary
questions.solution: B) Summary(noun) – A brief statement or account of the main points of something. सारांशAntonym:Lengthy(adjective) – Of considerable or unusual length, especially so as to be tedious. लंबा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Mighty
questions.solution:
A)Mighty(adjective) – Possessing great and impressive power or strength, especially on account of size. शक्तिशाली
Antonym:Weak(adjective) – Lacking the power to perform physically demanding tasks; lacking physical strength and energy. कमजोर

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Convalesce
questions.solution:
A)Convalesce(verb) – To recover one's health and strength over a period of time after an illness or operation. ठीक होना
Antonym:Collapse(verb) – To fall down or give way suddenly, often as a result of illness or injury. पतन होना

questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘resolve’
My cousin Nisha’s curiosity about life will never be satisfied because no one knows all the answers to all her questions
questions.solution:
B)Resolve(verb) – Settle or find a solution to (a problem, dispute, or contentious matter), determine, decide. समाधान करना
Antonym:Questions(noun) – Inquiries, interrogations, queries. प्रश्न

questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word ‘advance’.
Clive is a travel blogger who believes that with even an elementary or intermediate Knowledge of the local language, you can enjoy your travel more
questions.solution:
C)Advance(verb) – To move forward, progress, promote, proceed. प्रगति करना
Antonym:Elementary(adjective) – Basic, fundamental, rudimentary, initial. प्रारंभिक

questions.question: What is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘fluctuate’?
questions.solution:
A) Fluctuate(verb) – To change or cause to change position constantly, be or make unstable; to rise and fall irregularly.परिवर्तनशीलहोना
Antonym:Stabilise(verb) – To make or become unlikely to change, fail, or decline; to make stable.स्थिरकरना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Confound
questions.solution:
C)Confound(verb) – Cause surprise or confusion, perplex, bewilder. उलझाना
Antonym: Assure(verb) – Tell someone something positively to dispel doubts, reassure, Promise. आश्वस्त करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Oral
questions.solution:
B)Oral(adjective) – Spoken, vocal, related to the mouth. मौखिक
Antonym:Inscribed(adjective) – Written or engraved, especially on a surface. लिखित

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
Rapid
questions.solution:
D)Rapid(adjective) – Happening in a short time or at a great rate. तेज
Antonym:Slow(adjective) – Moving or operating, or designed to do so, only at a low speed; not quick or fast. धीमा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral, as the delicate pink petals bloom for only a short period
questions.solution:
C)Ephemeral(adjective) – Lasting for a very short time, fleeting, temporary. अल्पकालिक
Antonym:Permanent(adjective) – Lasting or intended to last indefinitely, enduring, perpetual. स्थायी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
Indians tend to be quite conservative in most aspects of life, particularly in rural areas
questions.solution:
A)Conservative(adjective) – Holding to traditional attitudes and values, cautious about change or innovation. रूढ़िवादी
Antonym:Liberal(adjective) – Open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values, progressive, broad-minded. उदार

questions.question: Which is the right set of ANTONYMS from the options for ‘Confidential’?
questions.solution:
A)Confidential(adjective) – Intended to be kept secret, private, not meant for public knowledge. गोपनीय
Antonyms:Familiar(adjective) – Well known, recognized, close. परिचित
Antonyms:Revealed(adjective) – Made known, disclosed, exposed. प्रकट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Aggravate
questions.solution:
B) Aggravate(verb) – Make (a problem, injury, or offense) worse or more serious. बिगाड़ना/ बदतर करना
Antonym:Alleviate(verb) – Make (suffering, deficiency, or a problem) less severe. कम करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
The government is proposing to incinerate cattle carcasses at many sites, some ofwhich are in populated areas
questions.solution:
C)Incinerate(verb) – To destroy (something, especially waste material) by burning. जलाना
Antonym:Extinguish(verb) – To put out (a fire or light); to cause (a fire or light) to cease burning. बुझाना
